name: Multiplayer
summary: Online play the Torque Shed way: host/join lobby (ENet, UPnP, UDP 24690), streaming each player's own car, the host running AI and race rules, and running a race offline, as host or as client (RaceSession).
notes: Bump Net.PROTOCOL_VERSION whenever a network message changes shape. Lobby players carry their "setup" (PROTOCOL_VERSION 9). Co-op crews (PROTOCOL_VERSION 12): lobby teams and roles, role swaps, driver changes that move the car to the new driver, team radio; see docs/COOP.md.
